notes.title: Our Discord server is now live! :)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44527621/05d22dac77c4273f2256c0f8fd2b19cc3c96b048.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! We're super excited to announce that we're launching our public Discord server for Echo of the Waves!

You can join right here: https://discord.gg/qF3DTUwAJ4

We plan on opening up most of the development process to the community, with public builds, playtesting and features voting 🙂 We already have an early version of the demo available there in case you'd like to try!

Looking forward to seeing you there!
